Commentary.Commentary: That's it from the game. We move to Mohali for the 4th ODI. With Australia back in this series. That match promises to be another exciting one. It will be played on Sunday, 10th March. It will begin at 1330 local (0800 GMT) Join us for that one. Till then, cheers!

Man of the Match, Usman Khawaja, says there is no better feeling than winning especially against a strong Indian side. Credits how Virat Kohli played but appreciates the effort by his bowlers. Mentions they wanted to bowl first as they were not sure what a good first innings total was but Finch and himself played really well. Reckons the wicket got slower as the game progressed. Ends by saying he is pleased with the runs he scored.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says it is a pretty decent effort by his boys. Credits how they batted and also appreciates the new ball bowlers. Feels it is important for the set batsman to continue as it is not easy for the new batsman coming in and that is exactly what Khawaja. He is working hard on his game and he is pleased with his effort today. Appreciates Khawaja's, Zampa's, Cummins' and Richardson's effort in this game.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they did well to pull back things towards the end and were quite optimistic about their chances of chasing this down. Felt that they expected dew to fall in the evening but that did not happen. Reckons that the wicket was not an easy one to bat on and you need to make use of the loose balls. States that early wickets made their task very difficult. Adds they have lost early wickets in this series, something which has not happened to them a lot often, hopes they can improve that. Says he is very pleased with his knock. Ends by saying there might be some few changes in the next game but they will be playing with the same mentality.

For Australia, Pat Cummins had yet another decent time with the ball. Zampa was expensive but it was his wickets which won them the game. Jhye Richardson impressed one and all and justified his selection. Stay tuned for the presentation in a while...

Australia though did not let the lost momentum affect them as they came out all guns blazing with the ball. Pat Cummins and Jhye Richardson were exceptional with the new ball as they dismissed the top order within Powerplay 1. Dhoni and Kohli then played themselves in and steadied the ship with a 59-run stand. However, the former was dismissed just as he started to get going. Jadhav then came out and it was his partnership with Kohli which brought India back in the game and changed the momentum. The two added 88 in 75 balls and revived hopes in the Indian camp. However, just as the tide seemed to be turning in the hosts favor Zampa struck. Kohli though continued, he along with Vijay Shankar built yet another 45-run stand with the skipper getting to his ton. The two were going great guns but it was once again Zampa, who got rid of the Indian skipper. Shankar then along with Jadeja did try to fight but the task was a very difficult one and in the end the Indians fell short quite comfortably.

THE SERIES IS STILL ALIVE! Australia have managed to make it 2-1. A very convincing performance by them. After quite a few matches one cay say the Aussies have put up a good performance with both, bat and ball. They were inserted and their openers came to the fore adding a massive 193-run stand. Usman Khawaja was the star as he scored the ton. They though did not end their innings with the bat with momentum on their side but still set a good enough target of 314 for the Indians.

OUT! In the air... taken! There goes the last man. Cummins takes it. It is his 3rd wicket of the game. Length ball on off, Kuldeep swings but only manages a top edge. It balloons towards Finch at mid off and he makes no mistake. All smiles in the Australian camp as they have WON BY 32 RUNS!
Short and outside off, Kuldeep looks to cut but misses.
A yorker on middle, Bumrah works it towards fine leg but no run taken.
Jasprit Bumrah is the last man in.

OUT! The fun is over! Shami departs and Richardson gets his second. Short and outside off. Shami looks to slap it but it goes off the toe end towards Cummins who takes it. Australia a wicket away now from winning their first game of the ODI series.

FOUR! That has been dragged into the gap! Slower ball, Shami was a little too early into the stroke, he still manages to drag it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Two boundaries now in this over, 2 balls to go.
A low full toss on middle, Shami hits it towards mid off.
FOUR! Shami is not going to go down without a fight here. He is off the mark in style. Short and on the body, Shami goes for the pull, he gets a top edge over the keeper and into the fence.
Mohammed Shami walks out at number 10.

OUT! Surely the game is now done, right? The last recognized batsman walks back. It is the off cutter. There is no pace at all on that delivery. Jadeja looks to go over mid on but holes out to the fielder there. Maxwell takes it easily.
Keeps strike now with a single towards point. 10 from this over, keeps India in the game. 41 needed in 3 overs.
Now goes back and works it towards deep mid-wicket. Takes one and then seeing Stoinis get to the ball slowly and completes it.
Maxwell goes back to firing it outside off, Jadeja cuts it to point.
SIX! India need a few more of these! Jadeja goes down on one knee and tonks it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
The quicker one around off, Jadeja keeps it out. A dot.
This is fired on the pads, Kuldeep works it around the corner and takes a single.
Glenn Maxwell is back on.
Once again Kuldeep takes a single of the last ball. Length ball outside off, Yadav hits it towards deep point and keeps the strike.
Slower delivery on the pads, Jadeja flicks it hard but there is fine leg for protection so only a single.
Another dot ball. Back of a length ball on off, Jadeja makes room on the leg side and hits it straight to the fielder at cover.
This time Kuldeep gets his bat on ball and hits it towards deep cover for a single.
Play and a miss. Slightly slower outside off, Kuldeep looks to hit it but misses.
Good length delivery on off, Yadav pushes it to the fielder at point.
In the air...but safe. Yadav sweeps it towards the fielder at deep square leg for a single.
Flighted on off, Yadav looks to defend but it comes off the outer half of his bat.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Ravindra milks it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Jadeja defends it off his front foot.
Flighted on middle and leg, Yadav nudges it towards long on and takes a single.
FOUR! Good shot from Kuldeep. Full on middle and leg, Yadav just nudges it towards the backward point region. The ball is timed perfectly and the ball races away to the fence.
Shortish and on middle, Yadav pulls it through square leg and keeps strike for the next over. Australia won't mind that.
Another defensive stroke and another dot! This will just build the pressure on Jadeja.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Back of a length on off, Yadav pushes it to covers.
Just ahead of a length on off, the ball stays a touch low. Yadav gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Length ball outside off, Jadeja guides it down to third man and a run is taken.
Kuldeep Yadav is the next batsman in.

OUT! Shankar holes out! India's possible last hope is walking back. He was well-set, striking the ball nicely but falls at the wrong time. Australia into the bowlers now. This is tossed up, around middle, Shankar goes for the slog sweep again. Hits it nicely but does not get the desired elevation. It goes towards the man at deep mid-wicket. Jhye Richardson there takes a good low catch. One though can question the shot as the runs needed per over was already hit in this one. However, Shankar must have thought another hit and the pressure would have eased big time. Had it come off, it would have been praised, it now has not and it is Australia's game to lose.
Tosses it up around off, Shankar keeps it out.

FOUR! In the gap! They need a boundary every over and Shankar has hit one in the last over and hits one in this. Brings out the slog sweep. It is not off the middle but hit well enough to clear the fielder at mid-wicket and away from the fielder in the deep.
On the stumps again, Jadeja goes back and works it through mid-wicket with soft hands. A single only.
This time they get two! Jadeja works it through mid-wicket, it is in the gap and they take two.

Good fielding! Shankar with the turn works it around the corner. He had played that with soft hands so there was a chance of a second but Cummins in the deep gets to the ball quickly and keeps it down to one.
A false start there! Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Nathan Lyon is back.

A single to end and 11 comes off the over! A good one for the hosts. 72 needed from the last 8 overs. Shankar goes back and pushes it through mid-wicket and keeps strike. Finishes off with figures of 10-0-70-3. He has been expensive but has taken three crucial wicket.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Shankar looks to sweep but misses.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary and a beautiful shot this. Makes room and also dances down the track. Gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Should have done better there Jadeja. He comes down the track and converts it into a full toss. He though only manages to hit it all along the ground down to long on for a run.
Goes flatter and on off, Shankar off the back foot works it around the corner for a run.
Very full again! Shankar hits it hard down to long on. They take one, see Marsh fumble and then go for the second. Complete it with ease.
Jadeja hits it down to long on and takes a single. Australia won't mind singles at the moment.
Good length and outside off, Jadeja looks to play it with an angled bat but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for another single.
Another slower ball and this one also does not bounce a lot. Shankar waits for it this time and works it towards short third man for a run.
Slower ball, that grips in the surface. Shankar is a little early into the shot and the ball hits his pads.
On the shorter side, Jadeja clears his front leg and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Jadeja pushes it straight to the fielder at point.
Length ball around off, Shankar guides it to third man for a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Now maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 50th over.

Another huge shout but not given! This one was closer! This pitches on the stumps. Jadeja looks to sweep but misses. He gets hit around the thigh area. The bowler puts in a loud shot but the umpire shakes his head. A tight over this, just 4 from it. 87 required in the last 10. Now then... I mentioned it was close, it was actually out. Hawk Eye shows three reds but Australia do not have a review. Will this cost them?
On the shorter side, the batsman goes back and guides it through point for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
This is worked with the turn towards mid-wicket. The fielder throws it to the keeper who fumbles. Shankar though of a run but is sent back by his partner.
Shankar goes back and punches it towards cover for a run.
Jadeja goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal follows but it is going down leg. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Good length ball outside off, Jadeja guides it towards third man for a single. He will keep the strike for the start of the next over.
Play and a miss. Length ball outside off. It is too close to cut but Jadeja tries it. He misses it and the ball goes to Carey.
Full length ball on middle and off, Ravindra strokes it straight to the fielder at mid off.
On middle, Jadeja tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, Jadeja plays it late to the point fielder and shouts a loud no to his partner.
Good length delivery on off, Shankar hits it towards point and takes a single.
On the stumps, it is worked towards mid-wicket. 10 runs from the over but also the wicket of Virat Kohli. This is probably the over which changes the whole complexion of the game.
Floats it up on off, Jadeja drives it to covers.
The leg spinner on middle, Jadeja works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket and takes two.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Zampa has the last laugh! He gets the man Australia desperately wanted. Zampa is pumped up. He has got all the three big wickets, first Dhoni, then Jadhav and now Kohli. Once again it is the full ball which does the trick for him. It lands on leg stump, Kohli looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses the leg pole. Kohli walks back after playing a brilliant innings but one feels, he takes the hopes of India chasing this down along with him. India need another 95 runs, however, there are now two all-rounders batting and only the bowlers to come. Australia right on top.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Zampa overcompensates and bowls it short on middle, Kohli goes back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. Zampa feeling the pressure here, two poor balls to begin with.

FOUR! Kohli is in some mood now! He is smashing everything at the moment. Full and outside off, Kohli strokes it wide of the cover fielder and away from the sweeper for a boundary. Ideal start to the over and pressure on the bowler now.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Almost plays it on! Slower ball outside off, Shankar plays it with an angled bat but he gets an inside edge which goes close past the leg pole and down to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Shankar gets right behind the line and defends it onto the ground.
Short ball, he latches onto it quickly and pulls it through square leg for a run.
On the pads, Kohli works it around the corner. Takes one and then goes for the second. Completes it with ease.
Length ball around off, Shankar opens the face and guides it ti third man for a single.
Pat Cummins is back on now.
Pitching outside leg, Shankar looks to flick but misses. The ball goes to the on side and they take a single. Leg bye signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Edge but India will take it. Short outside off, Shankar looks to cut it but gets a thick outside edge and it flies through the vacant slip region for a boundary.

Not Out! Shankar's leg went nowhere outside the crease. Flighted ball outside off, Shankar looks to sweep but misses. Carey takes the bails off in a flash. He appeals. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that Vijay's leg was inside the crease.
A stumping appeal has been taken upstairs. The Aussies do not look excited.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.

SIX! Virat goes down town. Flighted on off and middle, Kohli takes the aerial route and lofts it over long on. It goes high in the air and for a moment it looked like it will fall to the fielder. But it has enough on it to take it over the ropes.

Excellent fielding. First from Marsh and then from Cummins. Full length delivery on middle, Kohli hits it through mid on. Marsh runs to his left from long on and gets down in time and pulls it back. Cummins then pulls it back as the ball was going to the fence. He does well too. So only two runs.
Keeps strike now by working it through mid-wicket and getting to the other end.

100 for India's run machine. Back-to-back for him and it is his 41st ODI ton. What a player this guy is. Once again he is leading from the front and once again it is in a high-pressure situation. He gets there with a whip towards wide long on and takes two. The crowd is up here on its feet, giving him a standing ovation. The skipper though will know, the job is yet not done.
On the pads, Shankar flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.

NOT OUT! Yes it has pitched outside leg. Australia have lost their review here. Flighted ball pitching outside leg, Shankar looks to sweep but misses. There is a stifled appeal from Maxwell but they go upstairs for the review. Replays roll in and the Hawk eye show that it was pitching outside leg. Australia lose their review.
Australia have gone for a review here! A shout for an LBW has been turned down. Shankar is the man in question. Pitching looks to be an issue.
Flighted on off, Virat pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Was it a drop? Flighted outside off, Kohli looks to defend but misses. Carey misses the ball behind the stumps. Replays show that Kohli's bat hit his pad. So not a drop.
On middle and leg, Shankar finds the fielder at mid-wicket with his flick. End of a good tight over from Zampa, just 4 runs from it.
On the pads, Kohli flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Turn and bounce on that one. Leg spinner on off, Kohli sees it and blocks it.
Flighted on off, Vijay milks it to long off for a run.
Shorter on middle, Kohli gets on his back foot and hits it to mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Shankar hits it to long on and takes a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Flatter and on the stumps again, Kohli looks to work it on the leg side but gets it off the inner half towards square leg. A single.
On the stumps, it is pushed back to the bowler.

Nicely bowled now! This is pitched around off and it turns back in a little. Shankar looks to play with the turn but misses. The ball goes extremely close past the off pole, the keeper fails to collect it and a bye is taken.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is bowled quicker and outside off. Shankar goes back and then just uses the pace of the ball and guides it through point for a boundary.
Fired on middle, Shankar with the turn works it to mid-wicket.
On off, Shankar pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Flighted on the stumps, Shankar starts his innings with a solid defense.
Vijay Shankar is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Stun silence here in Ranchi. Tossed up delivery on off, Jadhav looks to sweep but misses and gets hit right in front. Zampa thinks he has got his man and  the umpire agrees with him and shows Jadhav the dreaded finger. A very unnecessary shot at this stage of the game. He thinks about the review for a minute but Kohli reckons he is a goner so Jadhav walks back. The 88-run stand has been broken and a crucial wicket for the Aussies as the partnership was looking dangerous. However, Virat Kohli is still out there so the game is definitely not over.
Tossed up ball on off, Jadhav blocks it.
Shorter in length, Kohli follows that boundary with a single down to long on.
FOUR! In the air...but safe. Leg spinner on off, Kohli hits it through point. It falls short of Maxwell who dives to his left and it goes past him for a boundary.
Adam Zampa is back on.
A single to end! 9 from this one and Indian need 145 from 114. Kohli guides this one towards point to retain strike.
On the fuller side around off, Kohli opens the face and strokes it to point.
Good line! On the stumps and Kohli can only defend it out.

FOUR! SLAPPED! What a shot this is! Not a very bad delivery that. Length and outside off, Kohli makes room and then hits it hard through covers and the ball races away to the fence. Already 8 from the over.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries here! On the pads and it is too easy for Kohli. He flicks it fine on the leg side and a boundary results.
Kohli uses his feet but Jhye bowls it short. It is played back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot by the Indian skipper. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Jhye Richardson is back on.

Risky from India this. Flighted ball on the pads, Jadhav flicks it to mid-wicket and looks for a quick single. Kohli responds swiftly and gets on his bike. Maxwell gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the keeper's end. He misses and they get their single. Replays show direct hit and Kohli would have been a goner.
Tossed up on off, Jadhav blocks it.
Shorter in length, Kohli punches it to long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Kohli sweeps it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Very poor from Lyon. Off spinner on the pads, Kohli just helps it on its way towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On the off pole, the last ball has been kept out. A very good second over by Maxwell, just 2 from it.
Full and on the pads, it is hit down towards wide long on for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
This is worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fires it outside off, Jadhav looks to cut but is a touch late into the shot. He gets beaten.
On the pads, Jadhav pads it away. Maxwell is appealing but not sure why.
Kedar works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Flighted outside off, Jadhav looks to sweep but gets hit on the pad.
Floated on leg, Jadhav flicks it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter on middle, Kohli milks it to long on for a single.
On the pads, Jadhav glances it to fine leg for a single. Brings up the 150 for India.
Played to the point region by Jadhav.
Nathan Lyon back on.
A single now as this is guided towards point. Good sensible batting and this partnership is moving along nicely. It accounts for 62 from 47 and India need 166 runs more.
FOUR! Hammered! Uses his feet and also makes room. Gets to the pitch of it and smashes it over the bowler' s head for a boundary. Second in the over.
This time Kohli gets bat on ball and works it through square leg for a run.

FOUR LEG BYES! This is tossed up on off, it turns back in. Kohli looks to flick but misses. It hits his pads and goes past the keeper for a boundary. Maxwell in the meantime is appealing but the umpire shakes his head. Glenn really likes it and he is trying to convince his captain to go for the review. Carey though feels it is doing a lot and they do not go for it. Hawk Eye later on shows that it is going over the stumps so a good decision to not review it.
Slower through the air on middle, KJ works it to short fine leg.
Fires it on off, Jadhav keeps it out.
Glenn Maxwell is on now.

FOUR! Excellent and effortless. Fuller ball on off, Kohli gets on his front foot and plays a textbook cover drive for a boundary. Gets the 50-run partnership between the two. 177 runs more required off 144 deliveries.
FOUR! Kohli is toying with the Aussies here. Good length delivery on middle, Kohli pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Jadhav guides it to third man and takes a run.
Length ball on off, Kedar blocks it with a classical front foot defense.
On middle and leg, Virat tucks it to the leg side for a single. Good batting this, following the boundary with a run.
FOUR! Virat Kohli has decided to attack Stoinis. Overpitched delivery on off, Kohli lofts it over cover and the ball crosses the rope on a bounce.
Now brings the sweep shot out by getting his front leg outside the line of the off stump. He misses and the ball hits the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head.
FOUR! That went to the fence like a tracer bullet! Short and on middle, Jadhav picks the length early and smashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted ball on middle, Jadhav hits it to the right of the bowler. He dives and saves a run for his side.
On the off pole, it is kept out.
Kohli now hits it through covers for a run.
Starts off with a short ball outside off, Jadhav pushes it through covers for a single.
Change of ends for Adam Zampa.
No he cannot.  Kohli thinks he has got enough in this over and blocks this length ball off his front foot.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Stoinis. Two boundaries in two balls for Kohli. It is on the pads, Kohli flicks it fine towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Can he make it three in three?
FOUR! Powerful shot. Back of a length delivery on off, Kohli picks the length early and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Jadhav looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. The Australian players appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Good length delivery on off, Jadhav comes down the track and blocks it.

Fifty for captain Kohli! Good length delivery on off, Kohli guides it to third man and takes a single to get to his 50th ODI fifty. The skipper has to convert this into a big one if India are to win this.
Marcus Stoinis is back on.
The quicker one and outside off, Kohli guides it towards point. He wants a run but Jadhav hesitates, in the end they go for it and complete it with ease. Back-to-back good overs for Lyon.
Nudges it on the leg side for an easy run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Slower through the air on off, it is kept out.
Another misfield! Short and on the pads, Kohli goes back and works it towards square leg. The fielder fails to catch the ball and a run is taken.
This is angled on off, Jadhav plays it late towards point and gets to the other end.

Outside off, Jadhav gets down on one knee and looks to sweep. He misses it and it hits him on his body. Zampa asks the question to the umpire but it is turned down. Leg bye stolen as the ball goes towards the third man region.
Shorter in length, Kohli pulls it away for a single.
On the pads, Virat tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flighted on off and middle, Virat blocks it.
Tossed up on off, Jadhav comes down the track and pushes it towards long off.
Leg spinner on off, Kohli pushes it towards cover and takes a single. That brings up the 100 for India.
Down the leg side. Kohli flicks it to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Goes back and the clips it through square leg for a run.
The straighter one this time, Kohli looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards short third man for a single.
Lands it outside off and it comes back in a little. Kohli waits for it and then guides it to short third man.
Works it with the turn on the leg side for a single.
On the stumps, the batsman goes back and defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Nothing can stop Kohli tonight. Shorter in length, Virat sees it and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower on off, Kedar pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Kedar defends it off his front foot.
FOUR! Beautiful. Shorter in length on off, Jadhav waits for it and cuts it through point to get off the mark with a boundary.
Tossed up ball on off, Kedar blocks it coming down the track.
Kedar Jadhav walks out at number 6.

OUT! TIMBER! Pin-drop silence here. A wicket at the right time for Australia and at the wrong time for India. Just as the runs started to come for the hosts, Zampa gets the dangerous Dhoni. A very full delivery there by Zampa, almost a yorker. Dhoni with no foot movement looks to whip it but only manages to get an inside edge onto the stumps. The Australians are pumped up and India now in a deeper hole.
This goes away with the angle, Dhoni opens the face of the bat and guides it through point for a run. 12 from the over and the runs have now started to come for India. 228 more needed in 186.
Uses his feet again but Lyon shortens his length and also bowls it outside off. Dhoni pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! HUGE! When Dhoni connects, it is going to end in the stands. Uses his feet and hits it with the spin so the risk in the shot is minimum. It goes over the mid-wicket stand.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.

Works it through the gap in the mid-wicket region and the batsmen take two. 50-run stand up, a very important one as the two joined association when India were in huge trouble. They though hold the key.
Paddle sweeps it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Down the leg side and it has been called a wide.
Slightly shorter again on middle, Kohli goes back and whips it through mid-wicket. This time the batsmen take two. 6 from Zampa's first.
A half-tracker this time too Dhoni fails to take full toll of it. He only pulls it for a single to deep square leg.
Very full on middle, Kohli hits it down to long on for a single.
Down the leg side, wided.

Uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of it. He looks to work it across the line but misses. Is hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. The ball rolls towards point so the batsmen take a leg bye.
Gets his line and length right and Dhoni keeps it out.
Dhoni misses out there! A gift to begin with by Zampa. Short and down the leg side. Dhoni looks to hit it fine but finds the fielder at short fine leg.

Drinks Break - Australia have their noses in front here. They got rid of the openers and Ambati Rayudu. However, Virat Kohli and MS Dhoni are steadying the ship here. This partnership is very crucial in this game and it will probably dictate which way the match will go. Also, Adam Zampa is into the attack.
Fires it on off, Kohli goes back and pushes it to covers. End of another good over by Lyon. He is keeping it tight.
Uses his feet again and looks to hit it hard on the leg side, it goes off the inner half and through backward square leg for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Dhoni pushes it to covers.
Dances down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. Dhoni works it towards mid-wicket.
This time he gets it away from the fielder there and takes an easy run.
Flatter and on middle, Kohli works it to square leg.
Good shot. Length delivery outside off, Dhoni plays the square cut wide of the third man fielder and gets a couple to see off the over.
Length delivery on off, Virat flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Kohli hits it straight to the mid off.
Played to the point region by Virat.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Virat flicks it wide of the mid-wicket fielder and gets a brace.
FOUR! Excellent! What a way to get to his 4000th ODI run as skipper. Good length delivery on off, Kohli whacks it from under his eyes through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, MS blocks it off his front foot.
On the pads, Kohli tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Kohli looks to defend but gets a slight inside edge onto the pad. Lyon goes up in appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
Flighted on off, Dhoni pushes it to cover for a single.
Short again on middle, Kohli plays it with the spin and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball on off, Kohli hits it to mid on.
Outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
A fumble and a run! On the middle pole, Dhoni works it towards mid on. Lyon from mid-wicket runs to his right, dives but deflects it away from the mid on fielder.  A single is taken.
On the off pole, Dhoni gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
On the fuller side, Dhoni strokes it nicely but finds the man at covers.
Just outside off, it is guided down to third man for a run.
Makes room and then hits it through covers but only for a single.
FOUR! Poor from Lyon. Bowls it on the pads, down the leg side. These are easy pickings for Kohli. He just guides it towards fine leg for a boundary. 50 up for India with this boundary.
Flighted on middle and leg, Kohli flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short again on off, MS hits it to cover and takes a single.
Shorter on middle, Dhoni punches it to the fielder at mid on.
On the pads, Kohli glances it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Off spinner, shorter in length. Kohli looks to pull but gets it off the inner half of the bat.
Nathan Lyon is on now.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, Dhoni looks to drive but misses. Good over from Cummins. Went past Dhoni's outside edge twice in the over.
Good length delivery on the pads, Kohli flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
This time he is able to push it to cover. It is a length ball on off by Cummins.
Beautiful line and length. Full length delivery on off. The ball moves away after pitching. Dhoni looks to drive it through covers but misses.
Length ball on off, Virat hits it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Good length delivery on off, Kohli guides it towards backward point.
Length ball on off, Dhoni defends it to see off the over. Just a single from the over.
This one keeps low. Good length ball on off and middle, Dhoni plays it late according to the bounce and taps it to mid on.
Fuller length ball on off and middle, Dhoni plays it to the fielder at mid on.
Length ball on off, MS pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Back of a length delivery on off, Dhoni blocks it.
Ouch! Back of a length delivery on the body. Kohli looks to pull but gets an inside edge and gets hit on the body. The ball goes wide of the keeper and they steal a single.
Power play 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders can now be placed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Better from Jhye! Bowls it in the 5th stump channel. The batter lets it be. End of Powerplay 1 and it is the visitors who have dominated it. India are 40 for 3 after it. 274 more needed in 240.
FOUR! Short and pulled away! It sits up to be hit! Dhoni goes back and pulls it hard through square leg for a boundary. Second in the over and the crowd here has started to find its voice.
Back of a length on off, MS punches it to mid off.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! Slightly short and a little width on offer. Dhoni goes back and guides it through cover-point for a boundary.
Angles it into the off pole, Dhoni gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
On the shorter side, Dhoni defends it.
BEATEN! Lands it outside off, Kohli at the very end looks to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
On the shorter side, Kohli nudges it to mid on.
Length ball on off, Dhoni pushes it towards mid off for a run.
On the middle pole, Kohli flicks it towards mid-wicket. Zampa there misfields and a run is conceded.
Dhoni takes a few steps down the track but Marcus bowls it on the pads. Dhoni looks to flick but misses. It brushes his pads and goes towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
On the shorter side around off, Dhoni pushes it to covers.
Marcus Stoinis introduced into the attack.
Slightly fuller again, Kohli mistimes it to mid off.
This time he gets it into the gap on the leg side, it is through mid-wicket and two taken.
Full and on middle, Kohli works it towards mid on. The fielder there moves to his right and stops it.
Wide outside off, Kohli leans into it and strokes but straight to the man at cover-point.
Good length and around off, Kohli opens the face and guides it to point.
Good length and around off, Kohli opens the face and guides it to point.
Full length delivery on off, Dhoni keeps it out to see off the over.
Back of a length outside off, Dhoni shoulders arms to it.
Length ball on the fourth stump line. Dhoni knows where his off stump is and leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on off, Dhoni blocks it. Huge cheer from the crowd as he blocks it.
The new man in is MS Dhoni. You know it when the crowd goes berserk. India are in a spot of bother and need something special from the skipper and former skipper.

OUT! Peach. Absolute peach. Length delivery pitching on middle and off bowled at 143.1 kph. It hits the surface and moves away slightly later on. Rayudu is beaten all ends up as he looks to defend. The ball hits the off pole and Rayudu has to walk back. That ball was unplayable. India are in deep, deep trouble here. Another failure for Ambati at number 4. He has missed another opportunity to nail his spot in this squad. India three down in no time here.
Cummins hits the deck hard on middle and off, Rayudu defends it towards point.
FOUR! SHOT! He makes batting look so easy. Outside off, Kohli gets behind it and places it late through backward point. The ball races away to the ropes.
Finally a run after 17 balls. Rayudu opens the bat face and helps it past point to get to the other end.
On off, Ambati pushes it to the cover region. Still no runs off Jhye.
Another peach! Moves away on a good length after pitching. Rayudu drives but the ball goes past his outside edge.
Jaffa! Length ball outside off, draws Rayudu forward who fails to put bat to ball.
Another good shot for no run. Fuller ball around off, Rayudu drives it to cover-point but for nothing.

FOUR! Kohli looks in the mood. Good length delivery outside off, Kohli whacks this through point and the ball races away to the fence. Only the fifth ball in his innings and he has timed all of them beautifully.
Beautiful timing. Good length delivery on off, Kohli punches it hard towards cover. Stoinis there gets his hand to it but cannot hold onto it. Two runs taken by Kohli.
Rayudu is off the mark straight away. Length ball around off, Rayudu guides it to third man for a single.
Ambati Rayudu is the new man in. Perfect opportunity for him to seal his spot for the big stage.

OUT! Excellent review. No inside edge and Sharma has to walk back. Good length delivery on off, the ball comes in after pitching. Rohit looks to play across the line but misses to get hit on the pads. The Australian players are convinced they have got their man, The umpire does not feel so. Pat Cummins has a chat with his skipper and then Finch goes for the review. Ultra Edge does show a spike but it is of the ball hitting the pad. Hawk Eye rolls in and shows Sharma is caught plumb in front. India lose both their openers. Rohit has a shocked reaction as he feels he has edged it. Ultra Edge though feels different. India lost their review early in their bowling, Australia have used it to perfection here.
Review time! An inside edge can save Rohit Sharma. Let's wait and watch.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Sharma blocks it off his back foot.

FOUR! Lucky for Sharma and very unlucky for Cummins. Inswinging ball just outside off, Sharma looks to play it to the off side but gets a thick inside edge. The ball misses the stumps and goes towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Maiden wicket from Jhye. Fuller ball around off, driven back to mid off by VK. Great start from the Aussie.
Make that 11 without a run. Kohli blocks it out under his eyes.
Around off, Kohli plays it to the point region.
Indian skipper Virat Kohli makes his way at number 3 to a huge cheer from the crowd.

OUT! GONE! Great catch and Maxwell makes it look so easy. On the fuller length again outside off. Dhawan reaches for it and cuts it. Cannot keep it down and the ball goes uppishly to Glenn at backward point. He moves to his right and takes it with two hands. An early loss for India and Dhawan's poor form continues. 9 balls without a run from Richardson.
Full again on off, Dhawan drives it but not past the cover region.
Fuller ball around middle. Dhawan plays it with a straight bat and blocks it.

SIX! Class. Pure class. Overpitched on off, Sharma does not use his power but just shows his class and timing and sends it over the bowler's head for a maximum. Rohit holds the pose fopr the camera's. Expensive over from Cummins started with a boundary, ended with a six. 10 runs off it.
Cross seam delivery on middle and off, Rohit taps it to the fielder at point.
Back of a length delivery around off, Sharma hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Length ball around off, Rohit pushes it to the same fielder at the same region.
No hurry here. Follows the boundary with a gentle push to cover. It is bowled on a length on off.
FOUR! First one for India and Rohit is off the mark. Good length delivery outside off, Sharma just uses the pace of the ball and guides it to backward point fence for a boundary.
Maiden first up for Jhye. Length delivery on off, Dhawan pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
5th dot of the over. Back of a length on the stumps, Dhawan blocks it.
Excellent cricket all-round. Full length delivery outside off, Dhawan drives it beautifully towards point. Maxwell at point dives to his right and stops a certain boundary. Dot ball it is at the end.
Inward movement on this one. It is on middle and leg, Dhawan tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, Shikhar guides it to the fielder at point.
Full length delivery on off, Dhawan hits it straight to the mid off fielder.
Jhye Richardson to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Dot to end the over. Just a single off the first over. This one is on a length on middle and off, Sharma defends it.
Finally a hint of inswing for Pat. Length delivery on off, Sharma looks to cut it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Lucky for him, on another day that might have chopped onto his stump.
On a length, Rohit taps it back to the bowler.No swing so far for Cummins.
Length delivery on off, Sharma pushes it to the same fielder at point.
Cummins pulls back of the length and bowls it on off, Sharma defends it and looks for a single as the ball goes towards the point fielder but Dhawan is not interested.
India off the mark straight away. Full length delivery on off, Dhawan hits it wide of mid off and gets off the mark.
We are back for the chase. Out walk Indian openers, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. Shikhar Dhawan to take the strike. Pat Cummins to start with the first new ball for Australia.
